messages:
Priya: FYI scheduling a rolling maintenance in us-east1 for fan firmware + NVLink micro-retry fix. Window: 2025-08-02 01:30-04:00 UTC. Expect ~8-12% served capacity drop during individual rack reboots.

Jonah: Which pools will see impact? Hosted, dedicated, or both? Any pinned dedicated racks?

Priya: Impact: hosted-gpu-us1-primary and us1-ephemeral-backfill. A few dedicated tenants pinned to rack-eu1 are unaffected. We'll avoid touching pinned racks.

Mei: KV cache concern: recommend node-level stagger + uncordon hook: 
```
/opt/redwood/bin/kvseed --region us-east1 --model common --parallel 6
```
Also add wait-for-kv-health (p95 < 60ms) before uncordon.

Arjun: Cost note: traffic that overflows to us-west1 may incur egress and burst GPUs. Estimate: $900 USD worst case for 3h if overflow sustained. Ops budget ok?

Priya: Budget approved but keep overflow <40m per rack. Plan: drain node-by-node (15m), flash fan-fw, soft-reboot, thermal-monitor 10m, uncordon. Racks sequenced 30m apart.

Jonah: Enable quant-128 fallback for latency-critical routes if p95 breaches threshold. Also shorten batching to minimize tail during the windows.

Mei: I'll post a short CS/status blurb: "Planned maintenance in us-east1. Possible transient latency increases; no expected data loss."

Arjun: Ops-bot create calendar event and page oncall at T-30. Add runbook RB-2219 and emit telemetry markers event=fan-fw-start/end.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "us-east1 fan-firmware + NVLink retry rolling maintenance" 2025-08-02 01:30-04:00 UTC. PagerDuty page scheduled at 01:00 UTC.

Priya: Preflight at 23:30 UTC for capacity checks and runbook dry-run. If any preflight fails abort and reschedule.

Jonah: Acknowledged. I'll update dashboards to capture per-tenant p95 and token-cost delta for the post-run report.

Mei: All set from CS side. Will notify VIP tenants and ask for any embargoed jobs.

Arjun: Good to go from infra. Ping here if anything unexpected during preflight.

Priya: Thanks team. Starting preflight at 23:30 UTC.
